messages:
Mira: Ran the dependency scan on Dedicated images this morning — found CVE-2026-4512 in grpcx 2.4.1 (cvss 6.8). Fix is in main @9f3b2c -> grpcx 2.4.3.
sec-bot: scan: /scans/dedicated/1802345678 results: 1 hit CVE-2026-4512. Affected: grpcx@2.4.1. Fix: 2.4.3. Jira: SEC-742.
Alex: Is this a straight dependency bump or does it change runtime behavior?
Mira: Bump + tiny init behavior change — hello-keepalive disabled by default now. Could impact customers with custom GRPC LBs inside VPCs.
Samir: Flagging KMS shim: our on-prem images init KMS/HSM during startup. Need to confirm ordering doesn't change (KMS calls before network stack up). Who can validate in vpc-lab?
Alex: I can run a lab spin on vpc-lab-6. What's branch naming for cherry-pick? Suggest: release/patch/grpcx-2.4.3-20260318
Mira: Works for me. Add image metadata tags: "customer:acme", "release:depfix-202603" for slices.
sec-bot: note: Dedicated customers cust-acme and cust-zenko still at 2.4.1. Exposure depends on public-facing proxies in their VPC (low likelihood).
Jen: If we cut an image slice, can we avoid touching control plane? Private customers expect image-only update typically.
Alex: Yes — runtime-only. No DB schema or RBAC changes. Canary plan: non-prod Dedicated pool -> affected customer pools -> private onprem tarball.
Mira: Testing checklist:
- cherry-pick + build image slice
- KMS/HSM init smoke (decrypt/encrypt)
- GRPC e2e hitting LB inside VPC
- verify audit logs include key-id+operation and principal
- 24h canary with traffic spike
Samir: For audit logs, ensure the same log key names. If principal changes, update our log parsing mappings and alerting dashboards.
Alex: Adding CI job: kms-shim unit tests + small vpc-lab e2e using hsm-sim. Will include SBOM diff check (proto-ssl-lib also updated).
Mira: For Private/offline customers: provide signed tarball + offline install instructions and checksums.
Jen: I'll prepare customer advisory draft in #customer-comm. Messaging: proactive patch, low/no-exploit evidence, expected minimal downtime. Include rollback steps and image digest.
Ops-oncall: I'll own canary monitoring and alerts. What SLA window are we aiming for?
Mira: Target timeline: triage + branch + PR in 24h, build + lab test 24-48h, canary + customer notifications within 72h. SEC-742 updated with timeline.
Alex: I'll cherry-pick commit 9f3b2c into release/patch/grpcx-2.4.3-20260318 and open PR. PR will include SBOM and image metadata changes.
Mira: Owners: Mira (triage/cherry-pick), Alex (build/tests), Jen (customer comms), Ops-oncall (monitoring), Samir (audit/KMS validation).
sec-bot: SEC-742 state -> backporting-in-progress. Attached: scanner output, affected customer list, recommended timeline.
Alex: Ping me when PR is open; I'll kick off lab build and post image digest here.
Mira: PR created: #4127, branch release/patch/grpcx-2.4.3-20260318. Commits: cherry-pick 9f3b2c. CI started.
Alex: CI green on unit tests, building image now.
Jen: Customer advisory posted draft: link -> https://docs.internal/customer-advisories/CVE-2026-4512-draft
Mira: Noted. I'll coordinate signed artifact generation and add offline package to the release notes.
Alex: Build complete. Image digest: sha256:abcd1234... Posting to artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/depfix/grpcx-2.4.3-20260318
Ops-oncall: Canary started in non-prod pool. Monitoring hooks set (latency, errors, audit events).
Mira: Closing loop: once canary 24h OK, we'll schedule push windows for affected Dedicated pools and coordinate onprem deliveries.
Alex: Closing — will update SEC-742 and this thread with final digests.
